name: Psychic Girls! ~Ore to Kanojo no Koi no Yukue~
original_name: サイキックガールズ! ～俺と彼女の恋のゆくえ～
source:
Takaharu Midou transfers to Kurishima Academy due to his parents' change in the workplace.
He takes other students' attention as most transfer students do, and especially,
Maho Tsukishima and Mitsuki Saionji get interested in him and they become friendly.
In fact, the two have supernatural abilities and are called "psychic girls"!

The school's annual event "Harvest Festival" is scheduled soon.
With preparation for the event and two psychic girls, his busy and fun school life begins.

[Taken from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/dlaf/=/link/work/aid/vndb/id/RJ236746.html] DL Site[/url]]
translation:
御堂贵晴因父母工作调动而转学到栗岛学园。
他像大多数转学生一样吸引其他学生的注意力，尤其是，
月岛真帆和西园寺光希对他产生了兴趣，他们变得友好起来。
事实上，两人都拥有超能力，被称为“通灵少女”！

学校一年一度的活动“丰收节”即将如期举行。
带着活动的准备和两个通灵的女孩，他忙碌而有趣的学校生活开始了。
